title: PUNCHY GUNS: SNAP CLOSE, THUMP FAR
why: His number 45, punchy arcade sound like CoD and Fortnite. A gun sounded the same at 50 and at 800, only quieter, and the same in a shed as in the open street. Now close shots (yours included) get a bright snap on top of the crack, the thing that makes a gun feel like it kicks. Far shots lose their bright edge and arrive as a low thump, the way distant gunfire really sounds, so you can tell how far a fight is by ear. And the place answers: two quick slaps off the walls inside a building, a short low roll in the open, a soft wash in the woods, a ring in a vault, a hiss over water. His v10.58 note still holds: the answer is a tenth of the crack or less and short, never the long wash he could hear way later.
now: Guns snap close up and thump far off, and the room or the street answers each shot.
